mods.abstract: Surgical silk is contained on a wooden spool covered in cellophane, inside a box which depicts an operating scene. Box reads "Not sterile--sterilize by boiling or steam sterilizer".
mods.note: Photographed by Claude Moore Health Sciences Library, Historical Collections and Services staff.
